_help: The shop panel on each toy page (right side on computers, under the toy on phones). Items are listed per toy id; 'default' is used for any toy without its own list. Each item: kind (Report, Book or Service), title, blurb, price (like "$9" or "Free"), url (the page where people buy or book; leave it empty and the button says Coming soon), button (the button words), cover (a picture in assets/, or leave it out for a drawn cover) and color (blue, coral, mint, violet or yellow) and icon (report, book, call, key, shield, coin, block, star, rocket) for the drawn cover.
